messages:
Priya S: Heads up — noticed a spike in TLS renegotiations for eu-west proxies starting ~12:10UTC. Correlates with last RBAC push for cert-rotator roles. :rotating_light:
Sam W: I saw the same. Errors show repeated `kms:Decrypt Deny` in proxy logs, then fallbacks to older certs and shorter TTLs — clients drop and reconnect.
Marta L: Can you paste log snippets?
Priya S: Paste of filtered logs:```
proxy-1 eu-west | 2024-06-02T12:12:03Z | cert-issuer: error fetching key: KMS.DecryptDenied: Access denied for principal: service-account:cert-rotator@eu-west
proxy-1 eu-west | 2024-06-02T12:12:04Z | handshake fallback -> use cached ephemeral cert (ttl remaining 14s)
proxy-3 eu-west | 2024-06-02T12:12:09Z | cert-issuer: error fetching key: KMS.DecryptDenied: Access denied for principal: service-account:cert-rotator@eu-west
```
Oncall Derrick: :eyes: that looks like the cert-rotator lost KMS decrypt after the RBAC change. Which change exactly?
Priya S: The change bound `roles/kms.decrypt` to `svc-cert-rotator` but only at regional scope for `eu-central`, not `eu-west`. The PR note was ambiguous — I think the devops team intended to restrict to central but missed cross-region needs.
Sam W: That explains it. Audits? audit-bot: ran query for `kms:Decrypt Deny` for the last 3h:```
SELECT timestamp, principal, resource, action FROM audit_logs
WHERE action = 'kms.decrypt' AND outcome = 'DENY' AND timestamp > now() - interval '3 hours'
ORDER BY timestamp DESC;
```
audit-bot: results: 8 denies, all principals `svc-cert-rotator@eu-west` targeting `projects/redwood-kms/keys/ephemeral-cert-key-eu-west`.
Marta L: Are there any recent rollouts of cert-rotator code? Could be a new key name mismatch.
Priya S: No code rollouts; only infra RBAC PR 4572 merged 12:05UTC.
Oncall Derrick: Immediate mitigation options?
Sam W: Short-term: revert the RBAC binding to restore previous access. Alternative: patch KMS IAM to include the eu-west binding for `svc-cert-rotator`. Revert is fastest.
Priya S: Agreed — revert PR 4572 to unblock. I'll open the revert and request expedited deploy.
Marta L: Also add a quick guard in cert-issuer: if KMS.Decrypt fails with DENY, log the full principal + role and tag as `rbac-related` so we can alert earlier.
Priya S: Good call. I'll add a lightweight metric and alert: `cert.kms.decrypt.denies` > 1 in 5m per region -> page.
Oncall Derrick: Who's owning the revert? Priya?
Priya S: I'll own it and tag infra. Revert PR: https://git.redwood/reverts/4580 (pending)
Sam W: After revert, we should run an audit query to check any certs that expired or rotated into cached fallbacks. Also run a handshake-sampling across eu-west to estimate client impact.
Marta L: We should also add a pre-merge CI check: if an IAM change touches `roles/kms.decrypt` or `svc-cert-rotator`, require a region impact checklist.
Priya S: Filed infra issue: https://issues.redwood/INFRA-2179 — include region-scoped IAM review and a playbook snippet.
Oncall Derrick: Postmortem action items?
Marta L: 1) Revert and confirm KMS decrypt success 2) Add alert + metric 3) Add CI gating for IAM region-scope 4) Run certificate freshness sweep and list affected proxies 5) Add audit log query to run as part of RBAC PR template
Priya S: Assigning: 1) Priya (revert + confirm), 2) Priya (alert + metric), 3) Sam (CI gating), 4) Marta (sweep), 5) Sam (audit query into PR template).
Sam W: I'll draft the CI check and PR template snippet.
Marta L: Sweep results will include a CSV of proxies with fallback counts. Will post here once ready.
Priya S: Revert deployed at 12:29UTC, rolling restart of cert-issuer in eu-west.
Priya S: Quick check logs after revert:```
proxy-1 eu-west | 2024-06-02T12:31:02Z | cert-issuer: decrypt OK for principal svc-cert-rotator@eu-west
proxy-1 eu-west | 2024-06-02T12:31:03Z | handshake success, using fresh ephemeral cert
```
Priya S: RTTs returning to baseline. I'll keep monitoring for 1h then mark incident resolved. :white_check_mark:
Oncall Derrick: Thanks — please add the audit query run and attach the CSV to the infra issue.
audit-bot: reminder logged: `INFRA-2179` updated with initial audit CSV (attached by Marta).
Sam W: Postmortem note: check whether any other regional service accounts were scoped only to eu-central during the RBAC change — running a quick script now.
Marta L: Adding follow-up: long-term we need a region-aware policy simulator to show missed principals during IAM reviews.
Priya S: Agree. Thanks all for fast responses. Closing thread in 1h after monitoring. :pray:
